name: Azure IoT Operations
short_description: Microsoft edge data platform that runs on Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes and provides OPC UA connectivity, a local MQTT broker and data flows for industrial sites.

evidence.quote: Before placing Azure IoT operations in this architecture
Azure IoT Operations fits into this edge side of the architecture.
Azure IoT operations and Microsoft Fabric can bridge those layers, but they don't create meaning on their own.
Azure IoT Operations is Microsoft's Edge Data Plane for this kind of architecture.
It runs on an Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster and includes industrial-focused services such as an MQTT broker
